answer: Anyone running 144 aliases hence needs 190 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in juniper, expire in ivory, and jade lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4092 identities would post 2319 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
